scope: read-only QA review of the SDF render-reference capture authoring slice: script identity and content audit, two scene fixtures (identity + independent pinned-MuJoCo static check), offline dry-run reproduction for both groups with CUDA masked, legacy 69-entry manifest, evidence manifests/encoding, commit scope, window material consistency, product independence, receipt claims; zero GPU, zero device execution, zero reference writes, no source edits

method.recompute: recompute.py (12 checks -> recompute.json; committed blobs via git cat-file)
method.dry_run_reproduction: target/mjwarp-parallel/venv/Scripts/python.exe -B scripts/capture_render_sdf.py --dry-run --group {sdf-mesh,sdf-occluder} --out-dir ... with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=99 (both exit 0; outputs field-identical to evidence logs)
method.scene_static_check: independent pinned-MuJoCo load of both XMLs (no warp import), compared field-by-field to logs/scene-check.json

legacy_manifest.scope: fixtures/render-bvh minus scene-sdf/ (incl. frozen shadow/hfield references)

must_fix_items.finding: the window material and expected-products declare that a non-empty --out-dir is a hard self-check (non-zero exit), but the script only validates that out-dir is inside fixtures/render-bvh/scene-sdf/, then calls out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); there is no non-empty refusal, so a rerun of the same group silently overwrites previous products
must_fix_items.fix: either add `if out_dir.exists() and any(out_dir.iterdir()): fail("--out-dir non-empty")` and rerun both dry-runs to refresh the evidence logs, or reword the window material/expected-products to state that overwriting an existing out-dir is allowed (then no dry-run refresh needed)

observations.text: three evidence JSON logs are UTF-16LE + CRLF (dryrun x2, scene-check); existing repo capture pattern (106 UTF-16 blobs under docs/development-evidence), recommend UTF-8/LF

derivation helpers (target/sdf-u2/derive_sdf_capture.py, scene_check.py) are not committed, so derivation is not reproducible from the repo alone; compensated by direct 427-line audit plus line-level diff vs the hfield skeleton (390/427 identical lines, 21 blocks)
CLI still accepts --repeat 1 while the window plan requires 2; with 1 the two_captures_bitwise_identical flag is trivially true; recommend enforcing 2 for real capture

docstring claim 'writes only under --out-dir' is inexact: real capture also writes the warp kernel cache to target/render-bvh/sdf-capture-cache (untracked, outside out-dir); dry-run compiles nothing so my rerun wrote nothing
the 'otherwise nothing is written' claim has a nuance: array mismatch writes nothing, but if arrays match and npz bytes differ the first npz files are already written before the failure
scene-check.json comes from an uncommitted helper; I re-derived every static fact independently with pinned MuJoCo and got 0 diffs, so the evidence itself is credible

the U2 range also contains the separate scene-mixed mechanical-card commits; scope was counted as 17 paths including both .normify cards, fixtures only add scene-sdf/{scene.xml,scene-mixed.xml}, existing 69 references untouched
